Elwha_Riverscape_reach_data.csv.entity_definition: Comma Separated Value (CSV) file containing riverscape snorkeling data on fish distribution and abundance.

fields.label: Reach_ID
fields.definition: Numeric identifier of Elwha River sampling reaches common among the four survey years, ordered longitudinally from upstream to downstream

fields.label: Reach_Code
fields.definition: A four-letter code corresponding to each sampling reach

fields.label: Reach_Name
fields.definition: Name of each reach based on geographic landmarks and features

fields.label: Year
fields.definition: Year of survey

fields.label: Reach_Length_km
fields.definition: The snorkeled length of each survey reach in kilometers

fields.label: Upstream_Reach_Boundary_rkm
fields.definition: The river kilometer demarcating the upstream reach boundary

fields.label: Downstream_Reach_Boundary_rkm
fields.definition: The river kilometer demarcating the downstream reach boundary

fields.label: Section
fields.definition: The section of the Elwha River as defined by the location of the two former dams located on the river

fields.label: Count_Saco
fields.definition: The number of adult Bull Trout counted in the reach during each snorkel survey

fields.label: Count_Onxx
fields.definition: The number of adult trout (either Rainbow Trout or Coastal Cutthroat Trout) counted during each snorkel survey

fields.label: Count_Onts
fields.definition: The number of adult Chinook Salmon counted during each snorkel survey

fields.label: Count_Onmy
fields.definition: The number of adult Steelhead trout counted during each snorkel survey

fields.label: Fish_km_Saco
fields.definition: The value of Count_Saco divided by Reach_Length_km

fields.label: Fish_km_Onxx
fields.definition: The value of Count_Onxx divided by Reach_Length_km

fields.label: Fish_km_Onts
fields.definition: The value of Count_Onts divided by Reach_Length_km

fields.label: Fish_km_Onmy
fields.definition: The value of Count_Onmy dvidided by Reach_Length_km

fields.label: JONTS
fields.definition: The percentage of each reach occupied by juvenile Chinook Salmon, calculated by dividing the total length of channel units in which juveniles were observed by the total length of all channel units. NA values given for years where no juvenile presence data were collected.

fields.label: JONKI
fields.definition: The percentage of each reach occupied by juvenile Coho Salmon, calculated by dividing the total length of channel units in which juveniles were observed by the total length of all channel units. NA values given for years where no juvenile presence data were collected.

fields.label: JONXX
fields.definition: The percentage of each reach occupied by juvenile trout  (Rainbow Trout, Steelhead, or Coastal Cutthroat Trout), calculated by dividing the total length of channel units in which juveniles were observed by the total length of all channel units. NA values given for years where no juvenile presence data were collected.

Elwha_Riverscape_reach_breaks.csv.entity_definition: Comma Separated Value (CSV) file containing data on reach geographic coordinates.

fields.label: reach_break
fields.definition: A label describing the start or end point of each reach. Reach names are derived from the field "reach_code" in the field data table.

fields.label: UTM_easting
fields.definition: The geographic coordinate (UTM easting) of the start or end point of each reach. Coordinates are in Universal Transverse Mercator (UTM) Zone 10N, North American Datum (NAD) 1983.

fields.label: UTM_northing
fields.definition: The geographic coordinate (UTM northing) of the start or end point of each reach. Coordinates are in Universal Transverse Mercator (UTM) Zone 10N, North American Datum (NAD) 1983.
